panel.summary: Static `exportPptx` import pulls the whole PPTX writer into the documents-list chunk
panel.evidence: `pptx-actions.ts` now statically imports `exportPptx` from `@wafflebase/slides` (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pptx-actions.ts:2). That module is imported statically by an unrelated consumer, `packages/frontend/src/app/documents/document-list.tsx:78` (`pickAndImportPptx`), so the entire DrawingML export tree (`packages/slides/src/export/pptx/*`, plus JSZip via `export/pptx/zip.ts:1`) is now pulled into the documents-list bundle for users who never open a deck. The sibling PDF path deliberately avoids this by dynamically importing pdf-lib inside `exportSlidesPdf` (see comment at packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pdf-actions.ts:22). Fix belongs on the new code: `await import("@wafflebase/slides")` inside `exportSlidesPptxAndDownload`, or split the export helper into its own module so the import-only consumer does not drag it in.
